QuestInfo.name: Vanished Mysterious Fabric
QuestInfo.0: The Mysterious Fabric disappeared from me all of a sudden.  I should go talk to Arwen.
QuestInfo.1: The Mysterious Fabric disappeared from me all of a sudden.  I went to go see Arwen and she said if the Mysterious Fabric isn't kept properly, it can melt away and disappear... She could make me another one but she would need more materials this time.  As Arwen requests, I should gather #b12 Snow Silks#k and bring it to her.\n\n#i4001166# #t4001166# #b#c4001166# / 12
QuestInfo.2: The Mysterious Fabric disappeared from me all of a sudden.  Arwen said it was because I didn't properly take care of it.  I brought her 12 more Snow Silks and she made me another one.

0.0: What's up this time?\r\n#L0##bMy Mysterious Cloth disappeared.#l
0.1: Sigh, I knew something was off. Mysterious Cloth is very high maintenance. You should have been more careful! If you want to make it again, we'll need more Snow Silk. Do you want to try again?

0.0: What is it this time?\r\n#L0##bThe Mysterious Fabric disappeared on me.#l
0.1: Ugh~ I knew this would happen.  The Mysterious Fabric is hard to maintain.  If you are careless with it even for a bit, it will melt and disappear.  You should've been more careful.  So are you here because you want another one?  This time, I'll need more Snow Silks.  You still want it?

yes.0: Bring 12 Snow Silks this time.  Since you were able to get me 10 Snow Silks last time, it shouldn't be a problem, right?  After all, it's your fault for not taking good care of it from the first place.

no.0: I didn't know you were such a quitter.  Well, it doesn't really matter to me.  As long as it's okay with you.

1.0: You're something else...bringing me all 12 Snow Silks.  Very well.  Wait here for a bit.

yes.0: Here you go.  Make sure to take good care of it this time.  Okay?

item.0: You have to bring me 12 Snow Silks this time.  What don't you understand?  12!
